acceptance.meaning: Encoded preservation and activity measurements only. Creator review is required; no measured learning or accessibility benefit.

proposal.reference_selection: Observed frame in the originally kept appearance class, selected with the reviewed cut points to minimize predicted boundary RMS. No blended or invented pixels.
proposal.meaning: Keep the more contrasting observed state steady during this interval; review both states. This may be instructional content.

policy.selection: Minimize worst predicted boundary RGB RMS, then sum, then maximize held duration. Observed references stay in the originally kept appearance class. Trim only; never extend the detected interval. Preserve first and last clip frames.

boundary_alignment.scope: Predicted selected-box RGB and selected-mean changes. Encoded selected/influence RGB and linear-mean checks independently decide acceptance.

stationary_detail.metric: Number of adjacent ROI-mean RGB changes >=8 codes. Interior and fixed whole-clip counts are separate; the latter includes both cut boundaries.

policy.selection: Minimize worst predicted boundary RGB RMS, then sum, then maximize held duration. Observed references stay in the originally kept appearance class. Trim only; never extend the detected interval. Preserve first and last clip frames.

encoded_boundary_checks.scope: Entry, return and clip-loop boundary; selected and influence boxes; mean absolute, RMS and maximum decoded RGB differences must each be no greater than source (1e-12 floating comparison tolerance, no perceptual budget). This is not a safety or human-benefit measure.

protected_content.scope: Every decoded RGB frame versus prepared source. Fixed areas; creator judges meaning and readability.

teaching_motion.meaning: Decoded sample changes, including codec variation; not semantic progress ticks, legibility or learning measurements. Source and edited teaching regions are compared at their original frame times.

summary.codec: Lossless H.264 High 4:4:4 Predictive, YUV420; verify browser playback separately
